# ATLAS Learning OS

> One surface for focus, memory, momentum and the people climbing beside you.

## About
ATLAS is an AI-powered learning platform that helps users build focus, retain knowledge, and collaborate with AI assistants.

## Features
- AI Chat Assistant
- Quiz Generator
- Auto Blog
- Dashboard

## API
- Blog API: /api/blog
- Assistant API: /api/assistant
